# Load datasets
```{r}
pheno<-as.data.frame(read_sav("All data-Peru PAGE -8-8-2017.sav"))
geno<-as.data.frame(read_excel("PAGE_Original_ID_map_and_Phenotype_Moms_07112019.xlsx", sheet=4)) # maternal
manifest<-as.data.frame(read_csv("UPDATED_Manifest_R21_samples_ePTD_PAGE_Ava_revDiana.csv"))

```

# Data cleaning
# early TB will be defined as deliveries occurring <= 34 weeks of gestation
# Other categories of early PTB are moderte preterm (32 weeks - 34 weeks) and very preterm (<= 31 weeks)
```{r}
# variables of interest
# case status: ideally, ePTB cases without PA 

## Psychopathology
# Maternal lifetime trauma (childhood, pregnancy) and antenatal psychopathology (depression, anxiety, and stress), 

## Sociodemographic
# parity, SES, Education, health perception, pre-pregnancy BMI, pregnancy BMI (not-measured), smoking, alcohol, and drug use in pregnancy

# Obstetric outcomes
# GAD, history of PTB, vaginal bleeding, placenta abruption, multiple-pregnancies

# Delivery outcomes
# child sex, BW, status at discharge, type of NICU stay (COMPLETE)


## reviewed list of variables 
#=================================================================================
variable_rev<-c(# maternal sociodemographic characteristics #
                "studyid","A2age","agegr","b1numpg","A3Ed","A4marry","a7work", "i3beer6","i10wine6","i17liq6",
                "i53cig6","i59acoc6","b4hibp", "e17prekg","e19htm","prebmi","prebmigr", "e2planned", "t9par","e21hltpg",
                # maternal GAD and ePTB status #
                "galmp", "gaus", "gafund","casestat",
                # maternal adverse health outcomes #
                "e9hibp","b7diab", "e7bleed1", "e8bleed2", "b2still", "t12still", "s6still",
                "t10pih","b6eclamp", "b2sab", "b2abort", "i81inf6", "i82infm", "n7injury", 
                "n8belly", "s16plpr","s20prom","t18mod",
                # maternal mental health outcomes #
                ### PHQ9
                "o1noint" ,"o2down",  "o3slp","o4tired", "o5eat",  "o6fail",  "o7conc",  "o8slow",  
                "o9hurt",  "o10diff",
                ### EPD
                "p1laugh","p2enjoy","p3blame","p4anx","p5scared","p6cope", "p7slp", "p8sad","p9cry","p10harm",
                ### IPV
                "q1threat", "q2injury", "q3kicked","q4force","q5insult","q6sworn", "q7infer","q8yelled",
                "q9scontrl", "q10jlous",  "q11affair", "q12famly","q13help",
                ### History of childhood physical abuse (Moms) #
                "qa1push", "qa2hit",  "qa3act",
                ### History of childhood sexual abuse (Moms) #
                "qa4touch", "qa5fond", "qa6attsex", "qa7dosex", "qa8boysx", "qa9int", "qa10sex",  
                # ### Suicide risk #
                "o9hurt", "p10harm",
                # Infant variables
                "t21bwt", "t22gend", "t23apg1", "t24apg2", "t25nurs", "t26dschg",
                # Saliva samples #
                "r6nbsal", "r5saliva")

length(variable_rev)
table(variable_rev %in% colnames(pheno)) # T 94


## New data set including only variables of interest
#=================================================================================
page_sub<-pheno %>% select(all_of(variable_rev)) ; dim(page_sub) # 2764  92
# free some space
rm(variable_rev)

# Derive variables of interest
#=================================================================================
table(is.na(page_sub$galmp), is.na(page_sub$gaus))  # 27 NAs between the two measures
table(is.na(page_sub$galmp), is.na(page_sub$gafund)) # 287 NAs between the two measures

# In terms of precision in GAD estimation, the order is: gaus > gafund > galmp
gad_plot <- data.frame(value = c(page_sub$gaus, page_sub$gafund, page_sub$galmp),
                       group = c(rep("gaus",   length(page_sub$gaus)), 
                                 rep("gafund", length(page_sub$gafund)), 
                                 rep("galmp",  length(page_sub$gafund))))
gad_plot$group<-as.factor(gad_plot$group)
gad_plot$group<-factor(gad_plot$group, levels = c("galmp", "gaus", "gafund"))
levels(gad_plot$group)
# Plot histogram for different measures of GAD
ggplot(gad_plot, aes(x = value, fill = group)) +
  geom_histogram(position = "identity", alpha = 0.5, bins = 45) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("gafund" = "#66C2A5", "galmp" = "#FC8D62", "gaus" = "#8DA0CB")) +
  labs(title = "Gestational age measures", x = "Gestational age at Delivery (weeks)", y = "Frequency") +
  theme_minimal()

# Note: high overlap between measures

## Create variable for Gestational Age (GA) in weeks based on 3 measures of "ga" available in original data set
page_r21<-page_sub
page_r21$gestAge<-page_r21$gaus; summary(page_r21$gestAge) # 1558 NA samples in "gaus" 
# do replacement of 49 NAs using "gafund"
table(page_r21$gestAge, page_r21$gafund, useNA = "always")
replaceIds49<-page_r21$studyid[is.na(page_r21$gaus) & !is.na(page_r21$gafund)]
length(replaceIds49); print(replaceIds49)
page_r21$gestAge[page_r21$studyid %in% replaceIds49]<-page_r21$gafund[page_r21$studyid %in% replaceIds49]
table(is.na(page_r21$gestAge)) # T 1509, 49 less NAs. Correct!
# replace remaining 1507 NAs using "galmp"
table(page_r21$gestAge, page_r21$galmp, useNA = "always")
replaceIds1507<-page_r21$studyid[is.na(page_r21$gestAge) & !is.na(page_r21$galmp)]; length(replaceIds1507)
page_r21$gestAge[page_r21$studyid %in% replaceIds1507]<-page_r21$galmp[page_r21$studyid %in% replaceIds1507]
sum(is.na(page_r21$gestAge)) # 2 NAs
summary(page_r21$gestAge)

## Create a derived variable for PTB status
# what cut-off for GA was used to define ePTD cases?
by(page_r21$gestAge, page_r21$casestat, summary)
#
# page_r21$casestat: 1 (ePTD case)
#    Min. 1st Qu.  Median    Mean 3rd Qu.    Max.       NA's 
#   20.00   27.00   31.00   29.79   33.00   38.00 ***      2   ### *** 38 weeks is not considered PTB
# --------------------------------------------------------------- 
# page_r21$casestat: 2 (ePTD control)
#    Min.       1st Qu.  Median   Mean  3rd Qu.    Max. 
#   34.00 ***   38.00   39.00     39.0   40.00   42.00   ### 34 is considered late PTB


# clean workspace
rm("page_sub", "replaceIds49","replaceIds1507", "replaceIds1509")
 

## Create variables for ePTB and PTB based on the derived "gestAge"
#=================================================================================
## recode casestat variable based on gestAge
page_r21 <- page_r21 %>% mutate(casestat_r=ifelse(casestat==1 & gestAge>=37, 2, 
                                            ifelse(casestat==2 & gestAge <37, 1, casestat)))

by(page_r21$gestAge, page_r21$casestat_r, summary)


# Very early PTB or ePTD (< 32 gestational weeks; ACOG definition)
page_r21<- page_r21 %>% mutate(ePTB=ifelse(gestAge <32, "ePTB case", 
                                    ifelse(gestAge >=32 & gestAge <37, "moderate PTB", "control")))
table(page_r21$ePTB, useNA = "always") 
# PTB 
page_r21<-page_r21 %>% mutate(PTB=ifelse(gestAge <37, "PTB case", "control"))
table(page_r21$PTB, useNA = "always") 
# composed PTB variable
page_r21<-page_r21 %>% mutate(PTBall=ifelse(gestAge < 28, "extreme PTB",
                                     ifelse(gestAge >=28 & gestAge <32, "very Preterm",
                                     ifelse(gestAge>=32 & gestAge<37, "moderate PTB", "control"))))
# order levels 
page_r21$PTBall<-factor(page_r21$PTBall, levels = c("control", "moderate PTB", "very Preterm", "extreme PTB"))
table(page_r21$PTBall, useNA = "always")  

# cross-validate ePTB, ePTD and PTBall definitions
table(page_r21$casestat_r, page_r21$ePTB, useNA = "always")
table(page_r21$casestat_r, page_r21$PTB, useNA = "always")
table(page_r21$casestat_r, page_r21$PTBall, useNA = "always")

table(page_r21$PTBall,page_r21$ePTB, useNA = "always")  
table(page_r21$PTBall,page_r21$PTB, useNA = "always")  

 


## Derive variables of interest for infants
#=================================================================================
## infant birth weight in Kg
page_r21$bwt_kg<-page_r21$t21bwt/1000
summary(page_r21$t21bwt);summary(page_r21$bwt_kg)
## Child sex
page_r21<-page_r21 %>% mutate(child_sex=ifelse(t22gend==1, "Male",
                                        ifelse(t22gend==2, "Female", NA)))
table(page_r21$child_sex, useNA = "always")
## Nursery
page_r21<-page_r21 %>% mutate(nursery=ifelse(t25nurs==1, "regular", ifelse(t25nurs==2, "NICU", NA)))
table(page_r21$nursery, useNA = "always") # 218 NAs
## Discharge status
page_r21<-page_r21 %>% mutate(dischstat=ifelse(t26dschg==1, "alive", ifelse(t26dschg==2, "dead", NA)))
table(page_r21$dischstat, useNA = "always") # 386 NAs
## APGAR score t24apg2
page_r21<-page_r21 %>% mutate(apgar_5min= t24apg2)


## Derive variables of interest for Moms
#=================================================================================
## Health perception before this pregnancy
page_r21<-page_r21 %>% mutate (pghlth=ifelse(e21hltpg >= 1 & e21hltpg < 4, "Good to Excellent", 
                                      ifelse(e21hltpg>=4, "Fair to Poor", NA)))
table(page_r21$pghlth, useNA = "always")
## Planned pregnancy
page_r21$e2planned<-as.factor(page_r21$e2planned)
page_r21$e2planned<-revalue(page_r21$e2planned, c("1"="No", "2"="Yes", "9"="Don't know"))
levels(page_r21$e2planned)[levels(page_r21$e2planned)=="Don't know"]<- NA
table(page_r21$e2planned, useNA = "always")

## BMI categories
page_r21<-page_r21 %>% mutate(prebmicat=ifelse(prebmi<18.5, "underweight", 
                                        ifelse(prebmi >= 18.5 & prebmi <= 24.9, "Normal weight",
                                        ifelse(prebmi>=25 & prebmi<=29.9, "Overweight",
                                        ifelse(prebmi >=30, "Obese", NA)))))

## Maternal age by groups
page_r21<-page_r21 %>% mutate(agegroup=ifelse(A2age>=18 & A2age<20, "< 20",
                                       ifelse(A2age>=20 & A2age<=29, "20-29",
                                       ifelse(A2age>=30 & A2age <=34, "30-34",
                                       ifelse(A2age>=35, ">=35", NA)))))
table(page_r21$agegroup, useNA = "always")

## Gravidity (total number of pregnancies a woman has had)
# b1numpg:including this pregnancy, how many times have you been pregnant?
page_r21<-page_r21 %>% mutate(gravidity=ifelse(b1numpg==1, "primiparous",
                                        ifelse(b1numpg > 1, "multiparous", NA)))
table(page_r21$gravidity, useNA = "always")

## Education
page_r21<-page_r21 %>% mutate(education=ifelse(A3Ed<=2, "<= high school", 
                                        ifelse(A3Ed > 2 & A3Ed < 9, "> high school", NA)))
table(page_r21$education, useNA = "always")

## marital status
page_r21<-page_r21 %>% mutate(marital=ifelse(A4marry==1, "Married/Living with partner",
                                     ifelse(A4marry>1, "Not married/Living alone", NA)))
table(page_r21$marital, useNA = "always")

## Employment in pregnancy
page_r21<-page_r21 %>% mutate(employed=ifelse(a7work==1, "No", ifelse(a7work==2, "Yes", NA)))
table(page_r21$employed, useNA = "always")

## Drinking in pregnancy (first 6 months of pregnancy)
page_r21<-page_r21 %>% mutate(drinkpreg=ifelse(i3beer6==2|i10wine6==2|i17liq6==2, "Yes",
                                        ifelse(i3beer6==1 & i10wine6==1 &i17liq6==1, "No", NA)))
table(page_r21$drinkpreg, useNA = "always")

## Smoking in pregnancy (first 6 months)
page_r21<-page_r21 %>% mutate(smokpreg=ifelse(i53cig6==1, "No",
                                       ifelse(i53cig6==2, "Yes", NA)))
table(page_r21$smokpreg, useNA = "always")

## Cocaine use in pregnancy (first 6 months)
page_r21<-page_r21 %>% mutate(drugspreg=ifelse(i59acoc6==1, "No", 
                                        ifelse(i59acoc6==2, "Yes", NA)))
table(page_r21$drugspreg, useNA = "always")

## Variables from Medical Records (questionnaire section Section S)
## Mode of delivery
page_r21<-page_r21 %>% mutate(modeDeliv=ifelse(t18mod <=2, "Natural", "c-section"))
table(page_r21$modeDeliv, useNA = "always")

# Stillbirth History
page_r21 <- page_r21 %>% mutate(stbprev=ifelse(b2still > 0 | t12still==2, "Yes", 
                                        ifelse(b2still == 0 | t12still==1, "No", NA)))
# Stillbirth Current pregnancy
page_r21<-page_r21 %>% mutate(stbcur=ifelse(s6still==2, "Yes",ifelse(s6still==1, "No", NA)))
table(page_r21$stbcur, useNA = "always")
## stillbirth Overall
page_r21<-page_r21 %>% mutate(stbpc=ifelse(stbprev=="Yes" & stbcur=="No", "past stb only",
                                     ifelse(stbprev=="No" & stbcur=="Yes", "curr stb only",
                                     ifelse(stbprev=="Yes" & stbcur=="Yes", "persistent stb", 
                                     ifelse(stbprev=="No" | stbcur=="No", "no stb", NA)))))
table(page_r21$stbpc, useNA = "always")

# PRECLAMPSIA
page_r21<-page_r21 %>% mutate(prclprev=ifelse(t10pih==2 |t10pih==3, "Yes", ifelse(t10pih==1 | t10pih==4, "No", NA )))
table(page_r21$prclprev, useNA = "always")
## preclampsia current
page_r21<-page_r21 %>% mutate(prclcur=ifelse(e9hibp==2, "Yes", ifelse(e9hibp==1, "No", NA)))
table(page_r21$prclcur, useNA = "always")
## preclampsia overall
page_r21<-page_r21 %>% mutate(prclpc=ifelse(prclprev=="Yes" & prclcur=="No", "past prcl only", 
                                      ifelse(prclprev=="No" & prclcur=="Yes", "curr prcl only",
                                      ifelse(prclprev=="Yes" & prclcur=="Yes", "persistent prcl",
                                      ifelse(prclprev=="No" | prclcur=="No", "no prcl", NA)))))
table(page_r21$prclpc, useNA = "always")

# ECLAMPSIA
page_r21<-page_r21 %>% mutate(eclprev=ifelse(t10pih==4 | b6eclamp==2, "Yes", ifelse(t10pih==1 | t10pih==2 | t10pih==3 | b6eclamp==1, "No", NA )))
table(page_r21$eclprev, useNA = "always")

# ABORTIONS: Spontaneous abortions/induced abortions (overall history)
page_r21<- page_r21 %>% mutate(abort=ifelse(b2sab > 0 | b2abort > 0, "Yes", ifelse(b2sab==0 & b2abort==0, "No", NA)))
table(page_r21$abort, useNA = "always")

# Parity (Refers to the number of pregnancies that have resulted in births (live or stillbirth) that reached 20 weeks or more of gestation)

# t9par: PARITY = # of live births >28 weeks (including this pregnancy)
page_r21<- page_r21 %>% mutate(parity=ifelse(t9par==0, "No live births", ifelse(t9par==1, "1 live birth", ifelse(t9par > 1, "multiple live births", NA))))
table(page_r21$parity, useNA = "always")

# recode IDs for gravidity based on data of parity
page_r21<- page_r21 %>% mutate(gravidity=ifelse(gravidity=="primiparous" & parity=="multiple live births", "multiparous",
                                         ifelse(is.na(gravidity) & parity=="multiple live births","multiparous",
                                                gravidity)))

table(page_r21$gravidity, page_r21$parity, useNA = "always")

# VAGINAL BLEEDING
page_r21<-page_r21 %>% mutate(vb=ifelse(e7bleed1==2 | e8bleed2==2, "bleeding in pregnancy", ifelse(e7bleed1==1 & e8bleed2==1, "No bleeding", NA)))
table(page_r21$vb, useNA = "always")

# PLACENTA ABRUPTION
page_r21<- page_r21 %>% mutate(pabrup=ifelse(casestat==3, "Yes", ifelse(casestat==4, "No", NA)))
table(page_r21$pabrup, useNA = "always")
table(page_r21$ePTB, page_r21$pabrup)

# PROM (preterm premature rupture of membranes)
# 1= No, 2=yes, 3=not recorded (normally is considered as condition not present in Medical records)
page_r21 <- page_r21 %>% mutate (pprom=ifelse(s20prom==1 | s20prom==3, "No", 
                                            ifelse(s20prom==2, "Yes", NA)))


# GDM history
page_r21<-page_r21 %>% mutate(gdm=ifelse(b7diab==2, "Yes", ifelse(b7diab==1, "No", NA)))
table(page_r21$gdm, useNA = "always")

# INFECTIONS (cold, flu, UTIs, fever, gI)
page_r21<- page_r21 %>% mutate(infpreg=ifelse(i81inf6>=1 & i81inf6 <3 | i82infm>=1 & i82infm < 3, "Yes - frequent",
                                       ifelse(i81inf6>=3 & i81inf6 <=4 | i82infm>=3 & i82infm <=4, "Yes - occasional",
                                       ifelse(i81inf6==5 & i81inf6==5, "No infections", NA))))
table(page_r21$infpreg, useNA = "always")

# ACCIDENTS in pregnancy
page_r21<-page_r21 %>% mutate(accdprg=ifelse(n8belly==2, "Yes - belly trauma",
                                      ifelse(n7injury==2, "Yes - other trauma",
                                      ifelse(n7injury==1  & n8belly==1, "No injury", NA))))

table(page_r21$accdprg, useNA = "always")

# PLACENTA PREVIA (current pregnancy)
page_r21<-page_r21 %>% mutate(plprv=ifelse(s16plpr==2, "Yes", ifelse(s16plpr==1, "No", NA)))
table(page_r21$plprv, useNA = "always")                       


# PHQ9
### Reserve Q9 to estimate risk of suicide in these mothers ****
page_r21<-page_r21 %>% mutate(phq8=rowSums(select(., o1noint:o8slow), na.rm=T))
summary(page_r21$phq8)
# calculate categories for depression
page_r21 <- page_r21 %>% mutate(phq8_cat=ifelse(phq8 > 0 & phq8 <= 4, "No depression", 
                                          ifelse(phq8 >4 & phq8 <=14, "Mild-Moderate depression",
                                          ifelse(phq8 >14, "Severe depression", NA))))
table(page_r21$phq8_cat, useNA = "always") 

# EPDS (Edinburgh Postonatal Depression)
### Scoring Q1,2,4:
# 0 As much as I ever did 
# 1 Rather less than I used to 
# 2 Definitely less than I used to 
# 3 Hardly at all 
### Scoring Q3, 5:10
# 3 Yes, most of the time 
# 2 Yes, quite often 
# 1 Only occasionally 
# 0 No, never 

colnames(page_r21)[grep("p1", colnames(page_r21))] # "p1laugh"   
colnames(page_r21)[grep("p10", colnames(page_r21))] # "p10harm"  
colnames(page_r21)[grep("epds", colnames(page_r21))] # none
# column index
grep("p1laugh", colnames(page_r21)); grep("p10harm", colnames(page_r21))
str(page_r21[ ,c(53:62)]); sapply(page_r21[, c(53:62)], function(x) table(x, useNA = "always"))
# convert to factors from numeric 
page_r212<-page_r21 %>% dplyr::mutate(across(53:62, as.character))
str(page_r212[,53:62])
# Revalue levels for Q1,Q2,Q4
page_r212<-page_r212 %>% dplyr::mutate(across(c(p1laugh, p2enjoy, p4anx),~ recode_factor(.,"1"="0", "2"="1", "3"="2", "4"="3")))
sapply(page_r212[, c("p1laugh", "p2enjoy", "p4anx")], function(x) table(x, useNA="always"))
sapply(page_r212[, c("p1laugh", "p2enjoy", "p4anx")], function(x) levels(x))
### Revalue levels for Q3,Q5-Q10
page_r212<-page_r212 %>% dplyr::mutate(across(c(p3blame, p5scared, p6cope, p7slp, p8sad, p9cry, p10harm), 
                                       ~recode_factor(.,"1"="3", "2"="2", "3"="1", "4"="0"))) 
sapply(page_r212[, c("p3blame", "p5scared", "p6cope", "p7slp", "p8sad", "p9cry", "p10harm")], function(x) levels(x))
sapply(page_r212[, c("p3blame", "p5scared", "p6cope", "p7slp", "p8sad", "p9cry", "p10harm")], function(x) table(x, useNA = "always"))
# Calculate score for EPDS using 10 items
page_r213<-page_r212 %>% dplyr::mutate(across(p1laugh:p10harm, ~as.numeric(as.character(.))))
str(page_r213[, c(53:62)])
page_r213<-page_r213 %>% mutate(epd10=rowSums(across(p1laugh:p10harm), na.rm=T))
summary(page_r213$epd10)
# calculate categories for EPDS-10
page_r213 <- page_r213 %>% mutate(epd10_cat=ifelse(epd10 <8 , "No postnatal depression", 
                                            ifelse(epd10 >=8 & epd10 <=13, "Mild-Moderate postnatal depression",
                                            ifelse(epd10 >=14, "Postnatal depression", NA))))
table(page_r213$epd10_cat, useNA = "always") 

# clear space
page_r21<-page_r213
rm(page_r212, page_r213)

# PARTNER VIOLENCE DURING THIS PREGNANCY
# CODES:
# 0. Never
# 1. Rarely (1 or 2 /month)
# 2. Sometimes (almost weekly)
# 3. Often (all the time)
grep("q1threat", colnames(page_r21)); grep("q13help", colnames(page_r21)); str(page_r21[ ,c(63:75)])
sapply(page_r21[, c(63:75)], function(x) table(x, useNA = "always"))
# Categorical IPV
page_r21<-page_r21 %>% mutate(ipv=ifelse(q1threat>=1 |q2injury>=1 |q3kicked>=1| q4force>=1| q5insult>=1| 
                                         q6sworn>=1| q7infer>=1| q8yelled>=1| q9scontrl>=1| q10jlous>=1| 
                                         q11affair>=1| q12famly>=1| q13help>=1, "Yes", "No"),
                              ipv_sev=ifelse(q1threat==0 &q2injury==0 &q3kicked==0& q4force==0& q5insult==0& 
                                         q6sworn==0& q7infer==0& q8yelled==0& q9scontrl==0& q10jlous==0& 
                                         q11affair==0& q12famly==0& q13help==0, "Never",
                                         ifelse(q1threat==1 |q2injury==1 |q3kicked==1| q4force==1| q5insult==1| 
                                         q6sworn==1| q7infer==1| q8yelled==1| q9scontrl==1| q10jlous==1| 
                                         q11affair==1| q12famly==1| q13help==1, "Moderate",
                                         ifelse(q1threat>1 |q2injury>1 |q3kicked>1| q4force>1| q5insult>1| 
                                         q6sworn>1| q7infer>1| q8yelled>1| q9scontrl>1| q10jlous>1| 
                                         q11affair>1| q12famly>1| q13help>1, "Severe", NA))),
                              ipv_ph=ifelse(q1threat>=1 |q2injury>=1 |q3kicked>=1, "Yes", "No"),
                              ipv_phsev=ifelse(q1threat==0 & q2injury==0 & q3kicked==0, "Never",
                                               ifelse(q1threat==1 | q2injury==1 | q3kicked==1, "Moderate",
                                                      ifelse(q1threat>1 | q2injury>1 | q3kicked>1, "Severe", NA))),
                              ipv_em=ifelse(q5insult>=1|q6sworn>=1| q7infer>=1| q8yelled>=1| q9scontrl>=1| 
                                            q10jlous>=1| q11affair>=1| q12famly>=1| q13help>=1, "Yes", "No"),
                              ipv_emsev=ifelse(q5insult==0 & q6sworn==0 & q7infer==0 & q8yelled==0 & q9scontrl==0& 
                                            q10jlous==0 & q11affair==0 & q12famly==0& q13help==0, "Never",
                                            ifelse(q5insult==1|q6sworn==1| q7infer==1| q8yelled==1| q9scontrl==1| 
                                            q10jlous==1| q11affair==1| q12famly==1| q13help==1, "Moderate",
                                            ifelse(q5insult>1|q6sworn>1| q7infer>1| q8yelled>1| q9scontrl>1| 
                                            q10jlous>1| q11affair>1| q12famly>1| q13help>1, "Severe", NA))),
                              ipv_sx=ifelse(q4force>=1, "Yes", "No"),
                              ipv_sxsev=ifelse(q4force==0, "Never", ifelse(q4force==1, "Moderate", ifelse(q4force>1, "Severe", NA))))
```

# Build Table 1 
```{r}
# Function to Describe population by child Sex
#================================================================================
require(DescTools)
pvalue <- function(x, ...) {
  # x <- x[-length(x)]  # Remove "overall" group
  y <- unlist(x)
  g <- factor(rep(1:length(x), times=sapply(x, length)))
  if (is.numeric(y)) {
    # For numeric variables with equal variance apply t-test, if not, Mann-Whitney-Wilcoxon test
    # check homoscedasticity assumption
    if (var.test(y ~ g)$p.value >= 0.05){
      # enter equal variance argument accordingly in t.test()
      p <- t.test(y ~ g, var.equal = T)$p.value
    } else {
      p <- wilcox.test(y ~ g)$p.value
    }
  } else {
    # for categorical vars, use Chi.square test if 2x2, otherwise (>2 x 2) use the Cochran–Armitage test
    if (length(levels(y)) > 2) {
      p <- CochranArmitageTest(table(y, g))$p.value
    } else {
      p <- chisq.test(table(y, g))$p.value
    }
  }
  c("", sub("<", "&lt;", format.pval(p, digits=3, eps=0.001)))
}


footnote<- "P calculated using t-test for continuous variables (Mann-Whitney-Wilcoxon test if unequal variance); Chi-squared test for binary variables; Cochran–Armitage test for ordinal variables"

```

```{r}
manifest<- manifest %>% select(Customer_Sample_ID:Gender, Species, verify_casestat)
str(manifest)

# verify case-control status of 4 samples considered as "case ePTB" in original manifest but that are actually controls
table(manifest$Control, manifest$Control_ref)
manifest<- manifest %>% mutate(verify_casestat=ifelse(Control_ref=="ePTB case" & Control=="Control", "Check", "OK"))
table(manifest$verify_casestat)

## verify distribution of cases-controls per box
table(manifest$Box_Number_New, manifest$Control_ref)
# Box  Control ePTB case
# 1      37        44
# 2      42        39
# 3      37        44
# 4      36        25
CochranArmitageTest(table(manifest$Box_Number_New, manifest$Control_ref))
# 	Cochran-Armitage test for trend
# 
# data:  table(manifest$Box_Number_New, manifest$Control_ref)
# Z = 1.1643, dim = 4, p-value = 0.2443  ** NO difference in Case-Control distribution across boxes**
# alternative hypothesis: two.sided


## verify distribution of cases-controls per box
table(manifest$Box_Number_New, manifest$Gender)
# Box Female Male
# 1     39   42
# 2     41   40
# 3     31   50
# 4     33   28
CochranArmitageTest(table(manifest$Box_Number_New, manifest$Gender))
# data:  table(manifest$Box_Number_New, manifest$Gender)
# Z = 0.022314, dim = 4, p-value = 0.9822 ** NO difference in sex distribution across boxes**
# alternative hypothesis: two.sided
```
